name: robotconsole
description: RobotConsole : terminaux, explorateur, tests, Docker et services dans une fenêtre, avec un petit robot par espace

scripts.test: npm run test:unit && node scripts/test-pty.js && npm run test:ui
scripts.test:unit: node --test scripts/test-platform.js scripts/test-speech.js scripts/test-subscriptions.js scripts/test-remote-editor.js scripts/test-remote-speech.js scripts/test-explorer-perf.js scripts/test-directory-perf.js scripts/test-prisma-perf.js scripts/test-speech-perf.js scripts/test-terminal-perf.js scripts/test-state-perf.js
scripts.test:perf: node --test scripts/test-explorer-perf.js scripts/test-directory-perf.js scripts/test-prisma-perf.js scripts/test-speech-perf.js scripts/test-terminal-perf.js scripts/test-state-perf.js && node scripts/test-restore-perf.js && node scripts/test-pty.js && node scripts/test-remote-terminal.js
scripts.test:speech: node --test scripts/test-speech.js && node scripts/test-speech-ui.js && node scripts/test-speech-app.js
